Remove old deprecations (#5672)

* Remove deprecated code since 0.11.x

* Drop TitleProp and deprecated plot.title = "str"

* Update bokeh.charts to use plot.title.text

* Remove deprecated `resources` argument from components()

* Remove deprecated layout functions (since 0.12.0)

* Remov
commits.author: Mateusz Paprocki

commits.message:
Unify and simplify deprecation of things

This replaces the old bokeh.util.deprecate (500+ loc) with
bokeh.util.deprecation (30+ loc). There is now one function
deprecated() that does the job. There are two signatures:

* deprecated((x, y, z), old, new, extra=None)

e.g. deprecated((0, 12, 4), 'Plot
